Class GodModeUiConfigurator

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.ui.godmode.GodModeUiConfigurator
public final class GodModeUiConfigurator extends Object
UI layout and control factory helper for GodModePanel.

Configures custom ComboBox cell factories with localized tooltips and constructs the physical event injector grid and card sections.

Version:
1.0.0-beta.3
Author:
Silvere Martin-Michiellot
